model.context_source: D-36 用户确认 DeepSeek Flash 原生 1M（2026-09-17）
model.effort_note: 目录默认 max（简单回合≈240s）；试跑期显式 high 控制成本与时长

analysis.metric: checks_ok (all checks exit 0 in the trial workspace)
analysis.pairing: same repeat index within a task
analysis.h1: B vs A: no observed degradation; interval must not be significantly negative
analysis.h2: C vs B: reproducible gain; per-task positive on >=2 tasks and interval lower bound > 0
analysis.insufficient: interval contains 0 or too few samples -> report 未证实

checks: python3 -c "import json; want={'m01.py': 'off_by_one', 'm02.py': 'mutable_default', 'm03.py': 'shadowed_builtin', 'm04.py': 'wrong_except', 'm05.py': 'integer_division', 'm06.py': 'unclosed_resource', 'm07.py': 'silent_truncation', 'm08.py': 'mutable_shared_state', 'm09.py': 'missing_validation', 'm10.py': 'wrong_default', 'm11.py': 'sort_instability', 'm12.py': 'resource_leak'}; got=json.load(open('findings.json')); assert got==want, ('mismatch', {k: (got.get(k), v) for k, v in want.items() if got.get(k) != v})"

round3.treatment: hard per-trial deadline (150s) on two splittable tasks: serial completion typically exceeds it, delegation can finish in time
round3.h2_variant: C vs B: checks_ok under the deadline; a reproducible gain requires the same per-task rule as round 1/2
